title: The context window: limits, truncation and strategies

videos.script: A long chat feels like a conversation with someone who remembers it. {{chat}} The model remembers nothing. Every time, it is sent the whole conversation again, and it reads only what fits in its window. {{window}} The window is a number of tokens. The instructions, the history, your new message and the reply all have to fit inside it. {{fit}} When a conversation grows past it, something is left out. Usually the oldest turns, and the model is not told. {{dropped}} In this lesson you watch a tiny model answer wrongly because the word that mattered fell out of its window. {{toy}} Then you cut a real conversation down to a budget, and see which turn disappears. It is the one that mattered. {{budget}} The last part is what to do about it: keep the instructions, carry a note forward, and send only what the question needs. {{strategies}}
